Depth is 424 m, in deep blue offshore waters.
The Gulf Stream's inshore edge is about 1210 km to the west of here, away from where blackfin tuna usually travel.
No chlorophyll reading here today (cloud cover or missing scene), so this score leans on temperature and depth.
